items.heading: Bipc Is the Intermediate Name
items.text: BiPC is the Intermediate name for Botany, Zoology, Physics and Chemistry, the same stream others call PCB. Nobody publishes one official figure for "high", so the table below shows what public pay samples say for each route.

items.heading: The Order Is a Judgement,
items.text: The order is a judgement, not a rule. A course ranks higher when pay can grow with skill, proof and a business layer, and lower when the only way up is a ladder of exams.

items.heading: Two Courses with the Same
items.text: Two courses with the same fresher pay can end up very far apart. What differs is the shape of the climb.
